parsed.main_gap: The central quadratic estimate (7) is asserted with 'details omitted' — no derivation of the key inequality |d(y)-d(t)| ≤ (y-t)^2/(4 min{t,y}) is given.

errors.description: The crux of the proof, estimate (7), is stated without derivation. It is in fact obtainable in a few lines from the AM–GM half alone (expanding (t+y+2c)^2 ≥ 4(t+c)(y+b) gives (t-y)^2 + 4(t+c)(c-b) ≥ 0), but as written the main lemma is unproved.
